name: baxter
description: Scrabble tournament manager. The cron entries keep the local player tables in step with their sources: pull_roster mirrors the central CoCo player database six-hourly (plans/PLAN_COCO_PROGRAM.md W4, tournaments/roster_sync.py), pull_wespa mirrors the WESPA rating list weekly (plans/PLAN_WESPA.md, tournaments/wespa_sync.py) -- weekly because WESPA ratings move when a rated tournament is processed, not on the hour. --no-sync runs straight from the image's venv: without it uv rebuilds the Rust extension in every one-off container, because the Dockerfile's COPY lands fresh mtimes on the crate sources after uv sync.
